description: Self-contained ThinkRail CLI that launches an AI coding workbench in your browser.
notes: Packages the standalone browser-launching CLI, not the native desktop installer. Run 'thinkrail' to open the workbench.
Tracks stable releases; upstream also publishes separate nightly builds.
Use 'scoop update thinkrail' and 'scoop uninstall thinkrail', not the upstream update/uninstall commands. The original release filename is preserved outside the upstream self-update layout.
User data remains in the upstream default ~/.thinkrail directory. Existing data is not moved or deleted; model provider authentication is configured separately.
